## What lives here
The service layer: Mistral agent, connector, library and conversation services, chat and orchestration, tool resolution and the registry, the workflow compiler and packager, revisions, attachments and the workflow engine (`workflow_engine/`).

## Conventions
<!-- Naming, file layout, patterns every file here follows (e.g. "one router per resource", "hooks start with use"). -->

## Entry points
Used by routes and layers. `tool_resolver.py` is the client of the Tool Service.
